craft_notes: Sthāyin: promise-joy. Rows: row 1 (lives-last). Rupture: colon after not. Close: dwelling. Rejected: 'dwell' — killed: lives breathes; line 1 keeps sadyaḥ as 'swift'.

lines: I tell it, doubt it not: swift Kaula-fruit it gives —
this Kaula rite, O Goddess, in my heart-sky lives.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kathayāmi na saṃdehaḥ sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | kauliko 'yaṃ vidhir devi mama hṛdvyomny avasthitaḥ

reads_against.argmap: No doubt, at once: the Kaula rite stands in my heart-sky — I tell it.
c1_essence: No doubt, at once: Kaula rite in heart-sky told.
